about.title: About me
about.p1: My passion for technology was born in the 4th year of ESO, participating in the First Lego League. A conversation with the dean of the UAB School of Engineering opened my eyes to the possibility of combining two of my great passions: the logic and structure of computer science with the creativity and practical application of electronics in telecommunications.
about.p2: I am especially fascinated by the confluence of both disciplines: computer architecture, embedded systems, microwave electronics... these are areas that allow me to understand technology from the transistor to software. This overview of the ICT world, where I can create and transform ideas into tangible realities, is what keeps me fully motivated.
about.languages: Languages: Catalan, Spanish, English (CAE, C1) and French (DELF B1).

placeholder1.title: Candy Crush Max!
placeholder1.description: Implementation of a clone of the famous match-3 puzzle game 'Candy Crush' using C++. The project includes game mechanics like candy swapping, match detection, and level management, providing a smooth and entertaining gameplay experience.

placeholder2.title: eShop
placeholder2.description: Implementation of an online store using HTML/CSS/JS for the frontend and PHP/MySQL for the backend. The project includes functionalities such as product navigation, shopping cart, payment process and user management, offering a complete and secure shopping experience.

placeholder3.title: Clothes Classifier
placeholder3.description: Implementation of a clothing classifier using machine learning techniques. The project allows classifying images of clothes based on their style, color and type, offering an automated solution for product categorization.

placeholder4.title: Moogle Max
placeholder4.description: Implementation of an optimal path finder using an OSM (OpenStreetMap) file. The project allows users to find the shortest route between two points on a map based on the distances between nodes.

vision.title: Motivation & future vision
vision.quote: "In search of the connection between academic theory and professional practice."
vision.p1: 5 years from now, I would like to see myself working as an engineer in an innovative technological product development team, especially in the field of intelligent systems, robotics or microelectronics.
vision.p2: I aspire to be a professional capable not only of executing solutions, but of proposing them, actively participating in the design of hardware-software architectures and, later on, leading projects.
